selection_rule: Cross-database analyses use the public MIT-LCP-anchored reference port. Source-native outputs are parallel comparison fields, carry their own time-scale and future-information receipts, and never overwrite the reference output.

reliability_scale.A: Public, version-pinned, complete phenotype implementation maintained by the database or study authors; still inherits documented clinical and ascertainment limitations.
reliability_scale.B: Public and version-pinned source-native implementation with material departures from complete dynamic KDIGO or restricted source prerequisites; suitable for compatibility or sensitivity analyses.
reliability_scale.C: Official source component or partial renal phenotype only; not a complete AKI staging authority.
reliability_scale.R: Public-reference semantic port used consistently across databases; differences from the pinned upstream implementation are explicit.
reliability_scale.H: Historical EasyICU phenotype retained only to reproduce sealed releases; not emitted by the current renal contract.

MIT_LCP_KDIGO_REFERENCE_PORT_V1.baseline_semantics: lowest observed strictly prior creatinine in [t-48h,t) and [t-168h,t)
MIT_LCP_KDIGO_REFERENCE_PORT_V1.urine_semantics: MIT-LCP thresholds applied to complete 6h/12h/24h normalized urine windows
MIT_LCP_KDIGO_REFERENCE_PORT_V1.rrt_semantics: active RRT evidence across databases; broader than the CRRT-only component in the pinned MIMIC-IV SQL
MIT_LCP_KDIGO_REFERENCE_PORT_V1.postprocessing: six-hour past-only rolling maximum at evaluated event rows
limitations: This is a transparent cross-database semantic port, not a database-native official field outside MIMIC-IV.
The treatment component uses all active RRT because CRRT modality is not uniformly available across databases.
Hourly source aggregation can differ from the exact event timestamps used by the upstream SQL.

EASYICU_KDIGO_STRICT_PRIOR_V1.baseline_semantics: lowest observed strictly prior creatinine in [t-48h,t) and [t-168h,t)
EASYICU_KDIGO_STRICT_PRIOR_V1.urine_semantics: interval-aware observed urine; complete 6h/12h/24h support; measured weight required; no LOCF or backward fill
EASYICU_KDIGO_STRICT_PRIOR_V1.rrt_semantics: explicit active RRT evidence; absent events are negative only after a completed source search
limitations: Cross-database harmonization cannot create pre-ICU history absent from a source.
A negative result requires explicit component and observation-window ascertainment.

sources.title: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury

MIMIC_IV_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.baseline_semantics: lowest strictly prior creatinine over 48h and 7d within the source extraction window
MIMIC_IV_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.urine_semantics: MIT-LCP interval sums requiring 6h/12h/24h documented duration
MIMIC_IV_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.rrt_semantics: CRRT rows with a non-null CRRT mode produce stage 3
limitations: Component NULL values are coalesced to zero in the combined stage.
The reference stage-3 treatment component is CRRT rather than every possible RRT modality.
The six-hour smoothed column is an engineering post-processing field, not a separate KDIGO criterion.

MIMIC_III_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.baseline_semantics: lowest strictly prior creatinine in the source query window, which is restricted to six hours before ICU through seven days after ICU admission
MIMIC_III_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.urine_semantics: legacy MIT-LCP window sums with reduced documentation-span thresholds (3h/6h/12h for nominal 6h/12h/24h windows)
MIMIC_III_MIT_LCP_KDIGO_D20B49A7.rrt_semantics: not included in the pinned kdigo_stages SQL
limitations: Urine documentation completeness thresholds are materially less strict than MIMIC-IV.
RRT is not included in the final pinned stage query.
Component NULL values are coalesced to zero.

HIRID_AKI_EWS_2024_BTAE212.baseline_semantics: published code combines pre-ICU creatinine when available with a whole-series/selected baseline strategy
HIRID_AKI_EWS_2024_BTAE212.urine_semantics: recorded urine rate normalized by weight and backward-filled on a five-minute grid before window evaluation
HIRID_AKI_EWS_2024_BTAE212.rrt_semantics: first available dialysis marker time produces stage 3 thereafter
required_sources: dialysis variables used by the publication
limitations: The public code targets HiRID-II, not the public HiRID 1.1.1 release used by current EasyICU exports.
Backward-filled urine and interpolated creatinine are intentional compatibility semantics and are not suitable for leakage-sensitive canonical analyses.
Exact reproduction must fail closed when publication-only auxiliary sources are unavailable.

sources.title: An empirical study on KDIGO-defined acute kidney injury prediction in the intensive care unit

SICDB_NATIVE_KDIGO_AKI_168_44A27CC8.baseline_semantics: first creatinine between -24h and the end of the 168h observation period
SICDB_NATIVE_KDIGO_AKI_168_44A27CC8.urine_semantics: hourly urine field evaluated with a fixed 70kg denominator and missing hours retained in the window denominator
SICDB_NATIVE_KDIGO_AKI_168_44A27CC8.rrt_semantics: any CRRT DataID 723 event in the first 168h produces stage 3
limitations: The upstream script fixes weight at 70kg even when patient weight exists.
Missing creatinine or urine evidence remains stage 0.
The output is a whole-window case summary and uses future observations relative to early ICU times.
The upstream authors warn that automated urine-output KDIGO may overestimate kidney injury.

AUMC_LEGACY_ACUTE_RENAL_FAILURE_8906394D.baseline_semantics: minimum creatinine from up to 365d before admission through 24h after admission
AUMC_LEGACY_ACUTE_RENAL_FAILURE_8906394D.urine_semantics: official legacy urine item mapping and outlier repair; not incorporated into the acute_renal_failure Boolean
AUMC_LEGACY_ACUTE_RENAL_FAILURE_8906394D.rrt_semantics: official RRT components exist separately; not incorporated into the acute_renal_failure Boolean
limitations: This is not complete KDIGO stage 0-3; it captures a stage-3-like creatinine definition only.
The baseline window includes the first 24h after admission and the outcome scans the first seven days.
The code belongs to the legacy 1.0.2 layout, not the current OMOP 1.5.0 layout.

EICU_OFFICIAL_RENAL_COMPONENTS_34CECE8C.baseline_semantics: no complete official eICU KDIGO baseline implementation was found in the pinned maintainer tree
EICU_OFFICIAL_RENAL_COMPONENTS_34CECE8C.urine_semantics: current cellvaluenumeric rows from the I&O|Output (ml) namespace; outputtotal is cumulative and excluded
EICU_OFFICIAL_RENAL_COMPONENTS_34CECE8C.rrt_semantics: no complete official eICU KDIGO stage implementation was found in the pinned maintainer tree
limitations: This profile intentionally does not emit an official AKI stage.
The public MIT-LCP reference port may consume the normalized official components, but that result remains a cross-database reference phenotype rather than an eICU-native AKI stage.
